description: Source code for a JST parser and template processing, including include handling, buffer management, and file loading logic.

classes.name: template_block
classes.description: Represents a block of template content, code, or string within the parser.

classes.name: growing_buffer
classes.description: Dynamic buffer used for accumulating output during template processing.

methods.name: buffer_init
methods.description: Initializes a growing_buffer with default size.

methods.name: buffer_push
methods.description: Appends data to a growing_buffer, reallocating as needed.

methods.name: buffer_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a growing_buffer.

methods.name: load_template_file
methods.description: Loads a template file, processes includes and JST tags, and returns the content.
